title: When Is It Too Smoky to Ride Outside? A Cyclist’s Guide to Air Quality
content:
Wildfire smoke and air pollution are increasingly health risks athletes have to contend with. Here's how athletes can assess risk and adjust their workouts when the air quality index is poor.

Read the full article at When Is It Too Smoky to Ride Outside? A Cyclist’s Guide to Air Quality on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
